ticker_news.title: 3 Reasons to Buy Taiwan Semiconductor Stock Like There's No Tomorrow
ticker_news.description: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSMC) is positioned as a critical player in the AI chip market, controlling 70% of chip manufacturing and serving major tech companies. The company shows strong revenue growth, potential for expansion in the semiconductor industry, and attractive valuation despite geopolitical risks.
ticker_news.author: Will Healy

ticker_news.title: Should Investors Own Vanguard's VOO ETF Over Invesco's QQQ for Broader Diversification?
ticker_news.description: The article compares Vanguard's VOO and Invesco's QQQ ETFs, highlighting VOO's broader diversification, lower expense ratio, and higher dividend yield, while QQQ offers more concentrated tech-driven growth with higher volatility.
ticker_news.author: Howard Smith
